text:
alex: Customer reports credits mismatch after trying to apply a second promo. Account acct_12345 — they say they had a free-trial applied (TRIAL50) then used a marketing code (PROMO10) and the account balance now shows only the PROMO10 amount and the trial is gone. Can someone confirm stacking rules and whether we can restore the trial?

alex: Repro steps customer gave (copied):
```
1) Promo page -> enter TRIAL50 -> received 50 credit
2) Later entered PROMO10 from newsletter -> UI accepted it
3) Balance now shows +10 credit, the original 50 disappeared
4) No charges yet, just credits
Account: acct_12345
```

maya: Thx. Policy-wise my recollection is that promo credits are not stackable by default (one active promo per account), but free-trial behavior can be special-case. Do we have server logs to show what happened when they applied PROMO10? Can someone try a quick repro on staging?

alex: I reproduced on staging. Sequence: apply TRIAL50 -> balance +50. Apply PROMO10 -> promo_apply event recorded, account.promo_id set to new id, credits recalculated to just the PROMO10 amount. Snippet from staging logs: 
```
2026-02-xxT12:03:20Z INFO promo_apply {"acct":"acct_12345","new_promo":"PROMO10","old_promo":"TRIAL50","action":"replace"}
2026-02-xxT12:03:20Z INFO balance_update {"acct":"acct_12345","old_balance":50,"new_balance":10}
```
Seems the system replaces the active promo, not stacks.

support-bot: Created internal ticket SUP-2026-7890 and notified billing.

oliver: Billing here — confirmation: current behavior is "last applied" replaces previous promo credit. Free trial is treated as a promo credit in the credits system, so applying another promo will overwrite it. We can manual-adjust: either restore the lost trial credit (one-time top-up) or issue a partial pro-rated adjustment depending on usage.

oliver: Ask: do we proceed with a manual restore of the $50 trial credit for acct_12345? Also recommending a UX note for marketing: warn that using a promo replaces existing credits.

alex: Customer is stuck on onboarding and needs the trial restored. Please go ahead with the $50 restore and update the ticket so I can close with the customer.

billing: Done — manually credited $50 to acct_12345 and documented action on SUP-2026-7890. What we did:
- Applied manual ledger credit +50 to acct_12345
- Added note: "restored trial after overwrite by PROMO10 on 2026-02-xx"
- Marked promo history to prevent re-applying TRIAL50 via UI (trial is one-time).
Customer message drafted: "We've restored your $50 trial credit. Note: promo codes cannot be stacked; applying a new promo will replace any existing promo credit on your account. If you intended to keep both, reply and we'll discuss options."

maya: Great, thanks everyone. I'll send the customer the message and close once they confirm. :thumbsup:
